It has a bright yellow bill and is positioned in profile facing right. The water reflects the duck's head and body.

The eye is visible as a small, dark spot on the green head, consistent with the taxonomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is visible at the rear, showing the characteristic upward curl of the central black feathers typical of mallard drakes.
